properties.geometry_method: reported/inferred bounding box shown against the target polygon

old_geometry_problem: Inherited rectangle -76 to -72, 41.5S to55S; excludes eastern Tierra del Fuego and southern bound57S, includes land and uses a constant longitude width. It is not the source study marine domain.
method: Approximate image-shading trace in geographic coordinates with independent land subtraction, geodesic WGS84 areas. Source map shading and stated latitudinal bounds used, no equal-width longitude approximation.
limitations: Raster grid/coastline calibration, source shading, coarse fjord/island land mask and discrepancy between traced/reported area preclude exact overlap. R includes Southern Patagonia to57.512S despite Humboldt label. A/B ranges incorporate traced-vs-reported S and map resolution.
range_basis: Trace yields A 7.1565%, B 94.3611%. Dividing traced overlap by reported 290000km² gives B 63.1783%; treating unresolved missing traced area as inner-fjord water inside R gives A approximately10.90%. Rounded7–11% /60–95% brackets cover these two source-area interpretations, not statistical intervals.
